Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that starts a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
import os
import time

class SpeechRecognizer:
    def __init__(self, speech_key: str, speech_region: str, language: str = "en-US"):
        self.speech_key = speech_key
        self.speech_region = speech_region
        self.language = language
        self.speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=self.speech_key, region=self.speech_region)
        self.speech_config.speech_recognition_language = self.language
        self.speech_config.request_word_level_timestamps()
        self.speech_config.set_service_property(name="punctuation", value="explicit", channel=speechsdk.ServicePropertyChannel.UriQueryParameter)
        self.recognizer = None
        self.done = False

    def recognized_cb(self, evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        print(f"RECOGNIZED: Text={evt.result.text}")
        if evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            # Optionally stop after the first recognized phrase or continue for continuous recognition
            # self.done = True
            pass
        elif evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            print("NOMATCH: Speech could not be recognized.")

    def canceled_cb(self, evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionCanceledEventArgs):
        print(f"CANCELED: Reason={evt.reason}")
        if evt.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={evt.error_details}")
            print(f"CANCELED: Did you set the speech key and region?")
        self.done = True

    def session_stopped_cb(self, evt: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        print(f"Session stopped event. {evt}")
        self.done = True

    def start_recognition_from_microphone(self):
        audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True)
        self.recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=self.speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

        self.recognizer.recognized.connect(self.recognized_cb)
        self.recognizer.canceled.connect(self.canceled_cb)
        self.recognizer.session_stopped.connect(self.session_stopped_cb)

        print("Say something into your microphone.")
        self.recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

        while not self.done:
            time.sleep(0.5)

        self.recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
        print("Recognition stopped.")

def recognize_streaming_speech(language: str = "en-US"):
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    speech_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not speech_region:
        raise ValueError("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables must be set.")

    recognizer_instance = SpeechRecognizer(speech_key, speech_region, language)
    recognizer_instance.start_recognition_from_microphone()

# Example usage (uncomment to run, ensure environment variables are set):
# if __name__ == "__main__":
#     recognize_streaming_speech(language="en-US")
